name: inventories
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,base64
L=Path.cwd()
def wr(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
bindings=json.loads(Path('original-bindings.json').read_text())
for b in bindings:
 raw=base64.b64decode(b['raw_base64']);tok=base64.b64decode(b['token_base64'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==b['raw_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(tok).hexdigest()==b['token_sha256']
 assert json.loads(tok)==b['record']['statement']
 assert hashlib.sha256(json.loads(tok).encode()).hexdigest()==b['statement_sha256']
 wr('originals/'+str(b['id'])+'.jsonl',raw.decode())
source=[
 {'file':'permutation','ids':[320185],'read':'Definitions1,3,5,7,10,18,20,22; Lemma2; Theorem7 full proof; pp9-10 inclusion/conjecture/appendix. Earlier canonical proof selective, not full dependency audit.','version':'arxiv1007.3467v1 header2010 internalJuly9,2021; no final equivalence'},
 {'file':'coloring','ids':[327213],'read':'pp1-4 proper coloring, total sums, classes, Theorem2.2; pp15-17 conclusion and Conjecture5.2. Product coloring proof bodies not audited.','version':'1402.0615v2 Dec8,2014; latest/final/correction not authenticated'},
 {'file':'cut','ids':[379841,379842],'read':'pp1-2 map and examples; Section3.2 full conjectures, face lemma and corollary. Clique-sum theorem referenced; entire proof not audited. Later split-model sections not relied on.','version':'math0606683v2 Feb12,2007; final not authenticated'},
 {'file':'rayleigh','ids':[379623],'read':'Graphic independent-set convention, Example5.2, Conjectures5.3-5.4; nearby two-sum statements. Not complete32page proof audit.','version':'math0602648v1 Feb28,2006'},
 {'file':'tropical','ids':[320886],'read':'Entire sixpage text, definitions1.1-1.4, Question1.7, Conjecture1.8, Example2.1 full proof, Theorem2.2. Finite matrix classification attributed, not independently enumerated.','version':'1012.5507v1 Dec26,2010'},
 {'file':'progression','ids':[317594],'read':'Entire final7page paper including all theorem/proof text; entropy/tensor dependencies attributed; new deduction explicitly supplied.','version':'Annals185(2017)331-337 final receivedMay5,2016 DOI10.4007/annals.2017.185.1.7'}]
for s in source:
 p=Path('sources/'+s['file']+'.pdf');s.update(sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=p.stat().st_size,figure_visual_inspection=False,proof_body_acquired=True)
wr('source-read-inventory.json',json.dumps(source,indent=2))
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
prev='0'*64
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 row=json.loads(raw);assert row['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert sum(r['event']=='attempt' for r in rows)==6
wr('http-inventory.json',json.dumps({'attempts':[r for r in rows if r['event']=='attempt'],'successes':[r for r in rows if r['event']=='success'],'denials':[],'redirects':[],'chain_tail_sha256':prev,'new_root_denial':'0809.0158 whole work binding; no delivery requested'},indent=2))
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert len(charges)==budget['calls_used']==3;assert sum(len(c['queries']) for c in charges)==budget['queries_used']==9
wr('search-inventory.json',json.dumps({'budget':budget,'charges':charges,'actual_saved_responses':['search-response-1.json','search-response-2.json','search-response-3.json'],'no_registry_clearance':True},indent=2))
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(L.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'file':p.name,**{k:o[k] for k in ['exit','killed','wall_s','sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes','samples','affinity','cpu_limit_s','as_limit_bytes','group_rss_guard_bytes','deadline_s','stderr']}})
wr('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps({'completed_receipts_before_this_invocation':receipts,'exceptions':['bootstrap20','standalone frozen verifier120'],'qualifications':'Sampling misses transients; native telemetry and separate writer peaks unavailable; no universal process compliance claim. This invocation and terminal manifest have their own later receipts.'},indent=2))
wr('access-inventory.json',json.dumps({'historical':'history-access.json exact832 authenticated paths; no further path following','original_corpus':sorted(set(b['chunk'] for b in bindings)),'own_files':'Terminal manifest lists all own files; run receipt command bodies record all local accesses','protected_filter':'Every path component before access; hat/formal/code-loop/polynexus/crown/tournament/bunkbed/r395/r463/r466/r482/r493/r494; later new tree review protected; no access','figures':'No visual figure inspection; no figure-dependent new endpoint'},indent=2))
print('20provenance bindings checked;6GETs;3search9strings; inventories saved; local failed receipt retained.')
